title: Took the traceability platform from a three-business pilot to a fourth business
summary: I conceived the AI-assisted traceability platform and guided its team through a pilot in three businesses. A fourth business adopted it after the pilot, and two more plan to adopt it in 2026.
what_would_have_happened: Trace work would stay manual and gaps would be found late, when they are expensive.
the_call: Grow business by business, one validated release at a time.
what_i_did: Set the design, secured funding and guided the team from the pilot to adoption.
what_changed: A fourth business adopted the platform after the pilot, two more are planned for 2026, and a quality program manager called my vision inspiring.

metrics.label: businesses using it after the pilot

quotes.text: Datta's communication and collaboration style is very positive and always looking for opportunities. It is simply lovely to collaborate with him. His vision is inspiring.
